summary: Engineering leader whose hands-on Python/PostgreSQL/Apache Airflow/Docker backend work concluded in 2018, before moving into non-technical engineering management; the skills below reflect that final individual-contributor stretch, not recent day-to-day work.

bullets.text: Led a team of 8 engineers delivering quarterly commodities-forecasting roadmaps at Prairie Grain Analytics.
Built Python REST API services and PostgreSQL schemas powering internal analytics tooling at Northern Pipeline Systems.
Owned PostgreSQL schema design and migrations for the core analytics warehouse at Northern Pipeline Systems.
Orchestrated nightly ETL with Apache Airflow DAGs across 8 data sources at Northern Pipeline Systems.
Containerized every backend service with Docker as part of the 2018 platform migration at Northern Pipeline Systems.
